Public test fixtures generated with Tauri CLI 2.11.5 using a throwaway key. The private key was created under /tmp and deleted immediately after signing. It is unrelated to production update signing.

`updater-payload.txt.sig` and `updater-public-key.txt` use the base64 wrappers consumed by Tauri. The payload is signed using the prehashed Ed25519 format (`ED`) with trusted version `1.2.3`.
